lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like array of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly horizontal rows and vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots are most prominent in the mid-flank region with a consistent inter-spot distance.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of white blobs to create a rectangular lattice pattern across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible running parallel to the body axis, indicated by a sharp transition from high luminance on the upper surface to shadow on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped indentation or notch is visible on the uppermost longitudinal ridge, approximately midway between the gills and the posterior edge of the visible flank.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high density of smaller, more irregularly spaced high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more uniform blobs on the main flank.
